📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💼 Contract Duration: 12 Months Extendable
🏢 Payroll: Marc Ellis
📅 Long-Term Opportunity
✅ Key Requirements:
• 7+ years of database development experience
• 5+ years in Oracle SQL/PLSQL
• Amazon Redshift
• AWS S3, Glue & EMR
• Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT & Data Modelling
• Python / PySpark
• High-volume data processing and automation
• Power BI, MicroStrategy or Tableau
• Agile & Git/version control experience
⭐ Airline/Aviation domain experience is highly preferred, particularly PNR, booking, passenger, revenue or flight data.

🚫 Do NOT send CVs via LinkedIn DM
✅ Click on the job link
